issue.title: Justfile SASE_ALLOW_STALE_CORE guard is a no-op across recipe lines
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `Justfile` recipe `_refresh-sase-core-checkout` (around the
  `SASE_ALLOW_STALE_CORE=1` guard), with the same broken pattern duplicated in
  `rust-install` and `rust-dev-install`.

Each `@`-prefixed recipe line runs as its own subshell in just, so

```just
@if [ "${SASE_ALLOW_STALE_CORE:-}" = "1" ]; then \
    exit 0; \
fi
@"{{ venv_bin }}/python" .../tools/refresh_linked_checkout ...
```

does not skip the fetch. The `exit 0` only ends that one line. Reproduced
directly: `env SASE_ALLOW_STALE_CORE=1 just _refresh-sase-core-checkout` still
fast-forwards the linked sase-core checkout.

Fix: restructure each guard into a single shell invocation so the skip
actually short-circuits the recipe.

PROPOSED BY: phase bead sase-qy.1. Workaround used during that phase: check
out the linked sase-core repo as a detached HEAD (`refresh_clean_linked_checkout`
skips detached checkouts) instead of relying on the env var.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by b76f53b99 'fix: repair guardrails for provider docs and proc imports'. Justfile:810-816 now joins the SASE_ALLOW_STALE_CORE early-exit and the refresh_linked_checkout call into one continued recipe line, and rust-install (840-842) gates the _refresh-sase-core-checkout delegation on the same variable instead of relying on a cross-line exit.
